turns.text: Never push code directly to production on Friday afternoon.
... Bro... your code has more bugs than an abandoned kitchen.
Wait—it was just one tiny button color change in CSS!
... You broke customer checkout in eight countries simultaneously.
Seriously? Show me the proof before my boss wakes up.
Look at step one: zero tests were run before pushing.
Wait, step two says the lead engineer is already hiking?
And step three: forty-seven emergency alerts fired in twelve seconds.
Bro... my hands are shaking. How do I fix this?
Check your screen: your CEO just messaged asking why revenue stopped.
... Enjoy your weekend unemployment. Comment FIX and I'll DM you the link.
